history.summary: A 527 sqft 99-yr-leasehold 1BR at Avenue South Residence (TOP 2023, D03) for $900k / $1,708 PSF, in the Greater Southern Waterfront corridor. A large, liquid 509-txn development at a sub-$1M quantum and ~24% below the $2,258 median PSF, but the new-launch-adjusted appreciation is essentially flat (~0.05-0.22%/yr) and Cantonment MRT is a poor 1.2km away.
history.rating_rationale: The post-new-launch-bias appreciation prints near-zero (0.05% adjusted / 0.22% resale-only) on a reliable 509-txn base — early resale buyers paid developer-inflated prices and gains have stalled. The $900k quantum and apparent ~24% discount to median PSF are attractive, but that median is inflated by larger/premium units; this shoebox at $1,708 PSF is not a true bargain. GSW is a real long-term catalyst, but 1.2km to the nearest MRT is weak. Balanced: strong liquidity and GSW upside vs flat realized appreciation and poor transit.

history.summary: The dossier price is almost certainly a mis-scrape: a 527sqft 1BR at $900k/$1,707 psf is far below every verified recent transaction (~$2,050-$2,750 psf), so the headline 'cheapness' is a data artifact, not a buyable bargain.
history.rating_rationale: Every verified recent comp for the identical 527sqft 1BR at Avenue South Residence trades $2,049-$2,751 psf (12-month average ~$2,252 psf; 6-month ~$2,241). The dossier's $1,707 psf ($900k) is ~24% below the cheapest real listing and would be unprecedented for a 2023-TOP RCR project by UOL/UIC/Kheng Leong. The -31.1% age-adj premium and -18.2% psf-vs-cohort are therefore driven by a bad price input, not genuine value. The underlying asset is high quality (award-winning UOL development, Greater Southern Waterfront and future Cantonment/Keppel CCL stations are real catalysts), but I cannot rate a Buy on a price that does not exist in the market. If the true asking is ~$1.18-1.35m it would be merely market-priced, not a bargain. Rating the data-as-presented: Avoid (unverifiable/erroneous price).
red_flags: Asking $1,707 psf is ~24% below the lowest verified recent 527sqft 1BR transaction (~$2,049 psf) - strong indicator of a mis-scraped or stale price
If price were real it would imply a distressed/erroneous listing that is unlikely to complete at that figure
The model's -31.1% and -18.2% discounts are artifacts of the bad price, not corroborated value
catalysts: Upcoming Cantonment and Keppel Circle Line MRT stations
